lastSession: 2026-06-28 — 4 egress fixes: uc-stats rewrite, MAP_PAGE_SIZE cap, lighter auth, GPS batching
currentPhase: Egress optimization — keeping under 5 GB/month for 70 staff delivery
currentStep: All 4 fixes implemented: uc-stats uses hierarchy + COUNT instead of 212K-row fetch, MAP_PAGE_SIZE reduced to 10K with server cap, deliveries/mark uses getSession() instead of getUser(), GPS reports batched client-side
keyDecisions: uc-stats: replaced 212K-row fetchAllRows with hierarchy reference table + per-UC COUNT queries (head:true). 4.2 MB → ~4 KB per call.
MAP_PAGE_SIZE reduced from 50000 to 10000 with server-side cap in survey-repository. Prevents unbounded batched fetches.
deliveries/mark: replaced sup.auth.getUser() (GoTrue API call) with sup.auth.getSession() (local cookie read). Saves 1 HTTP round-trip per delivery.
GPS batching: client buffers reports in array, flushes at 10 items or every 60s. Server accepts array of locations. Reduces Supabase queries from 4 per report to 3 per batch.
